insert into tcyr_cpa_colliding_data (package_id, priority, user_key) values
(#{item.packageId}, #{item.priority}, #{item.userKey})
on duplicate key update last_package_id = if(VALUES(priority) <= priority, package_id, last_package_id), package_id = if(VALUES(priority) <= priority, VALUES(package_id), package_id), priority = if(VALUES(priority) <= priority, VALUES(priority), priority)
